audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows contradicted their own explanations: Level 1 was given to Kennen while whys[0] says 'even-to-weak for you'; Level 2 was 'Skill' while whys[1] calls it 'your cleanest early window'; Level 3 was Olaf while whys[2] says 'it evens out'; first item was Olaf while whys[5] calls it 'a coin-flip on his Ragnarok timer'.
audit.why: 47.19% over 231 games: Kennen has one real early window at 2 and one at 6, and loses the stretches where Olaf's sustain and Reckless Swing carry him. The packet chart agrees on all four rows.
audit.corrected: L1 Skill, L2 Kennen, L3 Skill, Levels 4-5 Olaf, L6 Kennen, first item Skill, 2+ items Olaf.

audit.why: The spike map is right and unusually specific: Kennen at 2-3, Kennen at 6, Olaf whenever Ragnarok is up, Olaf at two items. Ragnarok is 100/90/80s against Slicing Maelstrom's flat 120s, so he can hold an answer for every ult you have.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical claims are wrong. (a) early says picking the axe back up spikes his attack and move speed — Undertow's pickup resets the ability's cooldown; the attack-speed/lifesteal ramp is Berserker Rage scaling off missing health. (b) late and spikes[2] attribute true damage to Ragnarok — the true damage is Reckless Swing (E), while Ragnarok grants disable immunity plus resistances.
audit.why: Riot text: Q Undertow (9s, 1000 range) 'If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset', with armour shred and slow. E Reckless Swing (325 range, 11/10/9/8/7s) deals true damage to target and himself. R Ragnarok — passive resistances, active immunity to disables while he keeps attacking.
audit.corrected: Dodging the axe denies a reset, not a speed buff; the true damage that ignores your MR is Reckless Swing, and Ragnarok is the CC immunity on top of it.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] advises buying MR against Olaf without qualification.
audit.why: His main single-target damage, Reckless Swing, is true damage and ignores MR entirely. MR still blunts nothing of his primary trade pattern, so it cannot be the headline buy.
audit.corrected: Prioritise the AP spike for the level-6 window and stop selling MR as the answer to Reckless Swing.
sources: olaf kit trueDamage flag and Riot text

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Olaf contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One Q chips him, but Undertow reaches 1000 to your 950 and you have no stun yet — farm and give him no free axe angle.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ragnarok's cooldown.
edits.after: Liandry's cashes the R combo, but Ragnarok (100s at rank 1) blanks it — fight only when his ult is down.

edits.before: Ragnarok makes him CC-immune, so your entire Mark of the Storm stun chain does nothing and he runs you down with true-damage axes - never fight into his ult.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes him CC-immune, so your Mark of the Storm chain does nothing while Reckless Swing's true damage runs you down - never fight into his ult.

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash - one Q poke and Electrical Surge autos chip him, but your body is fragile, so don't commit. Your real early window is Level 2-3: a second Q point plus W on-hit lets you stack marks for a stun trade and chip him before his axe lifesteal comes online. Dodge his axe (Q) - if it misses he has no slow and can't stick to you, so poke from max range and respect that once he picks the thrown axe back up his attack speed and move speed spike. Never let him stack the axe slow and walk onto your low-HP body.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash - one Q poke and Electrical Surge autos chip him, but your body is fragile, so don't commit. Your real early window is Level 2-3: a second Q point plus W on-hit lets you stack marks for a stun trade and chip him before his lifesteal ramps. Dodge Undertow (Q, 1000 range, 9s) - if it misses he has no slow and cannot stick to you, and remember that walking over the thrown axe resets that cooldown for free. Never let him land the slow and walk onto your low-HP body.

edits.before: This is where you lose. Once Olaf has lifesteal and bruiser HP your magic poke heals off instantly, he face-tanks your full combo, and Ragnarok's true damage ignores any shielding while making him immune to your stun chain - your one win condition is dead. As a squishy short-cooldown caster you get deleted the moment your R is on cooldown. Don't sidelane the 1v1 - you can't win it. Close on your 6/first-item spike, then pivot to grouping and using your AoE R as a teamfight engager where Olaf can only catch one person, not your whole team.
edits.after: This is where you lose. Once Olaf has lifesteal and bruiser HP your magic poke heals off instantly, he face-tanks your combo, and Reckless Swing's true damage ignores the MR you bought while Ragnarok makes him immune to your stun chain - your one win condition is dead. As a squishy short-cooldown caster you get deleted the moment your R is on cooldown. Don't sidelane the 1v1 - you can't win it. Close on your 6/first-item spike, then group and use your AoE R as a teamfight engager where Olaf catches one person, not your team.

edits.before: Buy MR/Mercs and rush your AP item to spike on the one window where your burst beats his bulk
edits.after: Rush your AP item for the one window your burst beats his bulk — MR does nothing to Reckless Swing

notes: The derived flag on Undertow reads 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes'; Riot's description of Undertow is armour shred plus slow with no grounding, so per instruction I trusted the description and asserted no grounding. Whether Mercury's Treads tenacity meaningfully shortens the Undertow slow is not answerable from the kits, so the boots line in report[8] was left alone.
